notes: Primary source is Jeremy's FREE YouTube CCNA course; every study item has a verified free YouTube video (see seed/source/youtube-playlist-2026-10-07.json).
JITL Academy (Teachable) URLs are kept only as optional secondary metadata (academyUrl, paid_optional) and never block progression.
Free lab files and flashcards are delivered via Jeremy's email signup (jitl.jp/ccna-files); per-lab file URLs are not published, so labFilesVerification is 'course_level'.
Durations are the YouTube durations; Academy durations are kept as academyDurationSec. Free YouTube lab videos are longer than the Academy lab clips.
Stable lesson/lecture/lab ids are unchanged from the Academy-based seed; see seed/source/stable-ids-pre-youtube-migration.json.
